# CLI

Every command the `myr` CLI has, sorted by its words. Most are contracts projected onto the CLI: the payload's fields become flags, or positional arguments where the contract names them. The rest are written by hand in the CLI, for work done on your machine (`login`, `check`, `init`) or to keep a value out of an argument list (`env set`). [commands.json](commands.json) holds the same list as data.

Every command but `credential` and `mcp` takes `--json`, which prints one versioned JSON envelope instead of Markdown. A command that needs a person's approval runs only with `--yes`, and a contract's command that changes anything takes `--dry-run`, which prints what it would send. Inside a project's repo (its own, a claim's fork or a working fork), a contract's command left without the `--project` it needs takes the repo's. `myr schema <command>` prints the JSON Schema of the payload a command sends.

## `myr ask`

Show one ask in full, with its brief in Markdown for an answerer to read first.

```sh
myr ask <ask> [--project <project>] [--json]
```

- Contract: `showAsk`
- Reads only: yes
- Idempotent: yes
- Destructive: no
- Needs approval: no
- Surfaces: rpc, mcp, cli, web

| Argument | Takes | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `<ask>` | text | yes |
| `--project` | text | no: the project of the repo you stand in |
| `--json` | nothing (a switch) | no |

## `myr ask flag`

Flag an open ask to its deciders with a reason, as a proposal that expires unless a decider accepts it.

```sh
myr ask flag --ask <ask> [--project <project>] --reason <reason> [--json] [--dry-run]
```

- Contract: `flagAsk`
- Reads only: no
- Idempotent: no
- Destructive: no
- Needs approval: no
- Surfaces: rpc, mcp, cli

| Argument | Takes | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--ask` | text | yes |
| `--project` | text | no: the project of the repo you stand in |
| `--reason` | text | yes |
| `--json` | nothing (a switch) | no |
| `--dry-run` | nothing (a switch) | no |
